answer: Counterparty-diversity gate: a river of deals must reach 12 unrelated counterparties to draw from the pool. Receipts are signed by the counterparty's own key; a velvet rope admits only 12-branch identities. Each epoch a zephyr draw audits 6%; rented counterparties burn a 60-credit bond. One fake: 60 bond plus 12 deals at 15, 240; 1,000 fakes: 240,000 against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent files 12 real deals once, keeps bond and share.
